subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-10-29

Next: FOCUS cluster exhausted for an 8th straight session (re-pulling fresh each round); checking shareable_dashboard's October 2026 ETA once the month ends; if the question-form pattern is judged a win, a future session could consider the shared H2s ("What you get with ARLO", FAQ header) that recur across all 6 pages — a more judgment-heavy, human-gated decision since those strings are shared, not persona-specific; generateSchema() wire-in and the unused _shell.html artifacts remain open.
